body: If the hub remains paired to an unavailable controller, hold the side button for eight seconds. Release it after the status ring flashes amber twice. The saved network settings remain unchanged.
Disconnect power for twenty seconds, reconnect the adapter, and wait until the status ring becomes steady white before reopening the control application.
Hold the side button for five seconds. Release it when the status ring flashes blue once. This procedure clears the current controller pairing.
Leave the adapter connected and hold the rear recovery switch for three seconds. The status ring turns white when recovery is complete.
Press the recessed rear switch for three seconds, then release it when the two port indicators blink together. Existing display preferences are retained.
Keep the sensor on a level surface and hold both arrow buttons for twelve seconds. Calibration is complete when the display shows a solid square.
On the Lyra Travel Router running firmware 3.0, select Guest Network, choose Reset Access Code, and confirm the prompt. Connected guest devices are disconnected.

Teams moving from Orion DeskHub firmware 4.2 to Atlas Dock firmware 4.2 should not assume that the pairing-reset workflows are identical. Use the procedure in the manual for the installed device and version.
